title: Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady Harvard Management Company's latest 13F shows it still holds 3,044,612 shares of BlackRock's iShares Bitcoin Trust, unchanged since March, a stake now worth about $110.6 million after bitcoin's slide. This post Harvard Holds 3.04 Million Bitcoin ETF Shares Steady first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Micah Zimmerman .
